title: A dress made of wind
alt: A graphite and watercolor fashion drawing shows a woman gathering the pleats of an ivory gown.
description: Fine human anatomy and complex garment structure in a delicate mixed-media illustration.
prompt: A breathtaking editorial fashion illustration combining precise graphite drawing with translucent watercolor. An adult woman stands in three-quarter view wearing an elaborate ivory dress whose layered pleats billow like sculpted wind around her body. The upper bodice, waist and sleeves are precisely tailored and physically attached, with one natural hand gathering a fold near her hip. Delicate cobalt brushwork flows through the skirt, while graphite construction lines describe the seams and fabric volume. Her face and hands are carefully drawn and anatomically coherent. Sophisticated airy composition on warm white paper, intricate flowing structure, no text.
